rare_definition: rare_exposure = sum of mix over clusters whose global token share (mix.mean(0)) is in the bottom quartile (<= 0.0056)

formulas.mean_residual: mean over the file's 12288 tokens of residual_(assigned)(x)
formulas.residual_frac: mean_residual / mean_total  (total = E||x-mu_global||^2, mu_global frozen from the trained cluster means)
formulas.mix_k: fraction of the file's 12288 cells assigned to cluster k

cell_maps.residual_map.npy: [13021, 12288] float32 -- residual_(assigned)(x) for every HEALPix cell of every file (NESTED ordering); row i is file_ids[i], NOT file id i
cell_maps.label_map.npy: [13021, 12288] int16 -- assigned cluster per cell, same row convention
cell_maps.row_axis: rows follow the sorted file list, identical to signatures.npz / file_summary.csv row order (file_ids)
cell_maps.normalisation: z[t,cell] = (residual_map[t,cell] - cell_mean_residual[cell]) / cell_std_residual[cell]  -- raw residuals are not comparable across cells
cell_maps.aligns_with: same [T, 12288] NESTED grid as runs/persistence/*/err_persist.npy (one row shorter there: transitions, not states)
